Motorist spots ‘nine-foot tall hairy critter’ in Colorado – FemaleFirst

Lori Bowling was driving through Hinsdale County with her husband Bill on July 28 and she was looking out of the window attempting to spot wildlife when she saw a massive creature emerge from the woods.

Lori submitted the sighting to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO), writing: “What I saw was plain as day. Trust me when I say I am not a Bigfoot believer, but after what I saw I sure in the hell am now!
